item.title: CSA holds cybersecurity capacity-building workshop for vice-chancellors
item.description: The Cyber Security Authority (CSA) in collaboration with Vice-Chancellors’ Ghana (VCG) has organised a capacity-building workshop for the vice-chancellors of the public universities in the country. The move aims to strengthen cybersecurity leadership and resilience within the tertiary education sector.
